Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art inventory sprite atlas for the humorous Korean fantasy game "Hero Extermination Incorporated", a company run by monsters. Create ONE precisely aligned 5-column by 5-row sprite sheet, square canvas, each cell identical size. Read the item list in row-major order. Each cell contains only its one listed object, centered, fully visible, occupying about 65% of the cell with generous empty padding on all sides. Clear chunky 32-bit pixel-art silhouettes, crisp stepped edges, rich restrained colors, dark outline, gentle upper-left light, readable at 48px. Whimsical medieval monster-office props; items must look distinct and match their names. Equipment rarity progresses from worn practical tools to extravagant enchanted executive relics. No writing, labels, letters, numbers, frames, grid lines, scenery, floor, cast shadow or watermark. Truly transparent alpha background, never draw a checkerboard.
